results.understood_as: List the regions whose revenue in Q4 2025 was lower than in Q3 2025.
results.sql:
WITH quarterly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.region,
    CASE
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-09-30'
      THEN 'Q3'
      WHEN o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-10-01' AND '2025-12-31'
      THEN 'Q4'
    END AS quarter,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
      1 - oi.discount
    )) AS revenue
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY
    c.region,
    quarter
), pivoted AS (
  SELECT
    region,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q3' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q3_revenue,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN quarter = 'Q4' THEN revenue ELSE 0 END), 2) AS q4_revenue
  FROM quarterly_revenue
  GROUP BY
    region
)
SELECT
  region,
  q3_revenue,
  q4_revenue
FROM pivoted
WHERE
  q4_revenue < q3_revenue
ORDER BY
  region
LIMIT 500

results.understood_as: What was the gross margin by category in 2025?
results.sql:
SELECT
  p.category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
    1 - oi.discount
  )), 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost), 2) AS cost,
  ROUND(
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
      1 - oi.discount
    )) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost),
    2
  ) AS gross_profit,
  ROUND(
    (
      SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
        1 - oi.discount
      )) - SUM(oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)
    ) / SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
      1 - oi.discount
    )),
    4
  ) AS gross_margin
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi
  ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped') AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025'
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 500

results.understood_as: By what percentage did October-November revenue grow in 2025 compared with October-November 2024?
results.sql:
WITH oct_nov_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) AS order_year,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (
      1 - oi.discount
    )) AS revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE
    o.status IN ('delivered', 'shipped')
    AND STRFTIME('%m', o.order_date) IN ('10', '11')
    AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) IN ('2024', '2025')
  GROUP BY
    STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(r2024.revenue, 2) AS revenue_2024,
  ROUND(r2025.revenue, 2) AS revenue_2025,
  ROUND((
    r2025.revenue - r2024.revenue
  ) / r2024.revenue * 100.0, 2) AS pct_growth
FROM oct_nov_revenue AS r2024

  ON r2024.order_year = '2024' AND r2025.order_year = '2025'
LIMIT 500
